Post Date: 2022-04-01T17:56:52Z

Title: Nesting AuthorizeView and Authorized components with various roles
Description: ### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [X] I have searched the existing issues

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe the problem.

I would like to have a section of a NavBar component wrapped in an `<AuthorizeView>` tag to limit access to only authorized users, but then use nested `<AuthorizeView Roles="admin, user, etc">` within to show/hide various options within the list, if shown. However, I can't use two `<AuthorizeView>` tags due to context conflicts.

This is similar to issue #20294 which was closed.

### Describe the solution you'd like

Be able to nest `<AuthorizeView>` tags with more restrictive roles in the inner tags to allow for showing/hiding content and subcontent
